definitions.gloss: every other year; biennial; alternate years
definitions.explanation: Occurring once every two years, or the interval of one year between occurrences.

examples.japanese: {隔年|かくねん}で{開催|かいさい}される。
examples.english: It is held every other year.

examples.japanese: この{展覧会|てんらんかい}は{隔年|かくねん}{開催|かいさい}だ。
{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}は{毎年|まいとし}ではなく、{隔年|かくねん}で{受|う}けている。
examples.english: I get a health checkup every other year, not every year.

notes:
A compound of {隔|かく} (interval, alternate) and {年|ねん} (year). The prefix {隔|かく} is productive and appears in similar time-interval words.

USAGE:
Often used as a modifier with で or as a prefix: {隔年|かくねん}で (every other year), {隔年|かくねん}{開催|かいさい} (biennial event). Common in formal and written contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {隔年|かくねん}で{開催|かいさい}する — to hold every other year
- {隔年|かくねん}{実施|じっし} — biennial implementation
- {隔年|かくねん}{発行|はっこう} — published every other year

RELATED TERMS:
- {隔月|かくげつ} — every other month
- {隔週|かくしゅう} — every other week
- {隔日|かくじつ} — every other day
- {毎年|まいとし} — every year
